rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an exaggeratedly joyful manner.

example.english: I was ecstatically happy after getting a present and couldn't sleep all night.
example.traditional: 我收到份禮物，開心到癲咁，成晚都瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 dou2 fan6 lai5 mat6 hoi1 sam1 dou3 din1 gam3 sing4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this idiomatic, more bookish expression when the ecstatic joy is especially intense.

example.english: They ecstatically told their family the good news after learning they had won.
example.traditional: 得知獲獎消息，佢欣喜若狂咁同屋企人報喜。
example.jyutping: dak1 zi1 wok6 zoeng2 siu1 sik1 keoi5 jan1 hei2 joek6 kwong4 gam3 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 bou3 hei2
